description:
Spangdahlem AB is anticipating the solicitation of the below contract. Be advised, this is NOT a solicitation, nor does it guarantee a solicitation for this requirement to be posted in the future.

This is an official pre-solicitation, this is anticipated to be a firm-fixed-price contract. 

This is only a pre-solicitation to notify prospective offerors. Feedback is encouraged. Quotes are not currently being requested. If your company is interested, please provide estimates from the pricing schedule attached. 

The purpose of this contract is to provide metal bunk beds, mattresses, wooden slats for beds, CONEX Boxes, Televisions, shop-vacs, linen sets, fans, and A/C units at Spangdahlem Air Base, Germany.
